<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_43b71b-30 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id12673_c43115-77 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_e25464-de inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h1 class="kt-adv-heading12673_31fcdf-bf wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_31fcdf-bf">kite trip mayapo | cabo de la vela | punta gallinas</h1>
<p class="kt-adv-heading12673_5271c9-1f wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_5271c9-1f">MAYAPO &#8211; CABO DE LA VELA &#8211; PUNTA GALLINAS &#8211; LA BOQUITA DUNAS DE TAROA</p>
</div></div>
</div></div></div></div>
</div></div>
<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id12673_e0f8b8-ef alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top kb-theme-content-width">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_0df766-d8 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id12673_8c707b-9b alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-row kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_ef9d22-ed inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<figure class="wp-block-kadence-image kb-image12673_859467-fe"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="427" height="640" src="https://www.kiteboardingcolombia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/KiteSafariColombia5.webp" alt=": Sunset kiteboarding in Dunas de Taroa" class="kb-img wp-image-13932" /></figure>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_319202-e6"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">

</div></div>
</div></div></div></div>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_0a4742-6d inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id12673_17b7d6-e8 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_7d1f4d-5c"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="kt-adv-heading12673_601395-d6 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_601395-d6">Kitesurf Adventure in La Guajira</h2>
<p class="kt-adv-heading12673_fe7f3c-b7 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_fe7f3c-b7"><strong>Kite Trip: Mayapo • Cabo de la Vela • Punta Gallinas</strong></p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Discover one of the most unique kitesurf trips in South America.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Join our&nbsp;<strong>La Guajira Kite Trip</strong>&nbsp;and explore remote desert landscapes, powerful Caribbean winds and untouched beaches while riding through some of Colombia’s most spectacular kite spots.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This adventure combines&nbsp;<strong>kitesurfing, culture, nature and road-trip exploration</strong>&nbsp;across one of the wildest regions of the country.</p>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_1491ba-db"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="kt-adv-heading12673_ba6a8c-17 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-1-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_ba6a8c-17">All levels welcome</h2>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-iconlist kt-svg-icon-list-items kt-svg-icon-list-items12673_aeb6d7-42 kt-svg-icon-list-columns-1 alignnone kt-list-icon-aligntop"><ul class="kt-svg-icon-list">

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id12673_54336e-b3 alignfull has-theme-palette9-background-color kt-row-has-bg wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top kb-theme-content-width">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_e7f1dc-63"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h3 class="kt-adv-heading12673_082faa-f1 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-3-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_082faa-f1">A Journey Beyond Kitesurfing</h3>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-12673_c04d24-f4"><div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center"><hr class="kt-divider"/></div></div>
<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id12673_43d983-e0 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-3-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_0e3860-9f"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h4 class="kt-adv-heading12673_190988-47 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_190988-47">Why La Guajira?</h4>
<p class="kt-adv-heading12673_706895-45 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-6-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_706895-45">Use this space to add a shLa Guajira is one of the&nbsp;<strong>best kitesurf destinations in Colombia</strong>, known for its strong and consistent trade winds, warm water and endless beaches.<br>During this trip you will ride across three iconic locations:<br><strong>Mayapo</strong>&nbsp;– Flat water and perfect conditions to start the trip<br><strong>Cabo de la Vela</strong>&nbsp;– A legendary kitesurf spot with strong winds and epic sunsets<br><strong>Punta Gallinas</strong>&nbsp;– The northernmost point of South America with remote beaches and breathtaking sceneryort description.</p>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_66e152-19"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h4 class="kt-adv-heading12673_be52b0-7e wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_be52b0-7e">The Ultimate Kite Adventure</h4>
<p class="kt-adv-heading12673_96f98c-4d wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-6-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_96f98c-4d">Use this space to add Our kite trip is more than just kitesurfing. It is an unforgettable journey through the desert of La Guajira.<br>Highlights of the experience:<br>&#8211; Kitesurf sessions in remote locations<br>&#8211; 4&#215;4 desert adventure<br>&#8211; Sunset sessions by the ocean<br>&#8211; Visit to the famous Taroa sand dunes<br>&#8211; Authentic Wayuu culturea short description.</p>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_46cc05-13"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h4 class="kt-adv-heading12673_5701a5-57 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_5701a5-57">What’s Included</h4>
<p class="kt-adv-heading12673_106971-db wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-6-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_106971-db">Use this space to add a short description.</p>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-iconlist kt-svg-icon-list-items kt-svg-icon-list-items12673_06d79a-e2 kt-svg-icon-list-columns-1 alignnone"><ul class="kt-svg-icon-list">
<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_34ac4f-43"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_checkCircle kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">4&#215;4 transportation during the trip</span></li>
<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_c9a20f-01"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_checkCircle kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">Professional kitesurf guide</span></li>

<h2 class="kt-adv-heading12673_67d25d-1c wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_67d25d-1c">Itinerary</h2>
</div></div>
</div></div>
<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id12673_2da15d-14 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-3-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_8a837d-69 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="kt-adv-heading12673_5f3452-64 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_5f3452-64">Day 01</h2>
<h5 class="kt-adv-heading12673_0ce1be-01 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_0ce1be-01">MAYAPO</h5>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-12673_dc3d9a-1b alignnone"><div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center"><hr class="kt-divider"/></div></div>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Arrival and first kite session to warm up.</p>

<h5 class="kt-adv-heading12673_1074f4-d7 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_1074f4-d7">Cabo de la vela</h5>

<h5 class="kt-adv-heading12673_8368d7-7d wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_8368d7-7d">Cabo de la Vela &#8211; Punta Gallinas</h5>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Early in the morning, travel north through dunes and salt flats to reach Punta Gallinas — the northernmost tip of South America. Afternoon kite session in untouched lagoons surrounded by desert cliffs.</p>

<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_e2b60b-d9 kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">09:00 am arrival at <a href="https://www.instagram.com/hospedajeluzmila/">Luzmila</a></span></li>

<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_fde714-57 kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">01:00 pm lunch</span></li>
<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_0fd5f3-43 kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">02:00 pm kite session</span></li>
<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_668e3e-90 kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">05:00 pm sunset at Dunes of Taroa</span></li>

</ul></div>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_7dfd3e-59 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="kt-adv-heading12673_6fea9c-bc wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_6fea9c-bc">Day 06</h2>
<h5 class="kt-adv-heading12673_873491-8d wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_873491-8d">Punta Gallinas</h5>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-12673_d731f9-1f alignnone"><div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center"><hr class="kt-divider"/></div></div>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Experience one of the most unforgettable rides of the trip: a&nbsp;<strong>downwinder to La Boquita</strong>, gliding along untouched coastline and desert cliffs. Stop for a&nbsp;<strong>picnic at Punta Aguja</strong>, where turquoise water meets golden sand. Return to camp by boat or 4&#215;4 for a relaxed evening.</p>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-iconlist kt-svg-icon-list-items kt-svg-icon-list-items12673_ff1a1d-4e kt-svg-icon-list-columns-1 alignnone kt-list-icon-aligntop"><ul class="kt-svg-icon-list">

<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_f51ca7-ec kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">02:00 pm afternoon kite session at la Boquita </span></li>
<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_7ab4d6-ae kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">04:00 pm back to the hotel </span></li>
<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_309ae2-01 kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">07:00 pm dinner</span></li>

<h2 class="kt-adv-heading12673_911a47-26 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_911a47-26">Day 07</h2>
<h5 class="kt-adv-heading12673_284712-cf wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_284712-cf">Punta Gallinas &#8211; Riohacha</h5>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-12673_328fa3-31 alignnone"><div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center"><hr class="kt-divider"/></div></div>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Early departure through the desert back to Riohacha or Mayapo, arriving mid-morning. Optional extension or transfer available if you’d like to stay longer in La Guajira.</p>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-iconlist kt-svg-icon-list-items kt-svg-icon-list-items12673_e386e7-e2 kt-svg-icon-list-columns-1 alignnone kt-list-icon-aligntop"><ul class="kt-svg-icon-list">
<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_aa0e7a-68 kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">05:00 am transfer to Riohacha </span></li>
<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_4774b2-d7 kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">11:00 pm arrival at Mayapo or Riohacha</span></li>
<li class="wp-block-kadence-listitem kt-svg-icon-list-item-wrap kt-svg-icon-list-item-12673_fec912-5f kt-svg-icon-list-style-default"><span class="kb-svg-icon-wrap kb-svg-icon-fe_clock kt-svg-icon-list-single"></span><span class="kt-svg-icon-list-text">02:00 pm end of the Kite Trip</span></li>
</ul></div>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_0e6a50-c5 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="kt-adv-heading12673_236e0d-1b wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_236e0d-1b">3n/ 4d trip</h2>
<h5 class="kt-adv-heading12673_2fb136-d1 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_2fb136-d1"><strong>4 Days / 3 Nights – Express Trip</strong></h5>
<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-12673_71eec8-f7 alignnone"><div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center"><hr class="kt-divider"/></div></div>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Day 1 – Riohacha → Cabo de la Vela</strong><br>Morning departure and afternoon kite session in Cabo de la Vela. Sunset at Pilón de Azúcar.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Day 2 – Cabo de la Vela → Punta Gallinas</strong><br>Travel north across the desert to Punta Gallinas. Afternoon kite session.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Day 3 – Punta Gallinas Downwinder &amp; Picnic</strong><br>Epic downwinder to&nbsp;<strong>La Boquita</strong>&nbsp;and picnic at&nbsp;<strong>Punta Aguja</strong>. Return to camp and enjoy the desert sunset.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Day 4 – Early Return to Riohacha / Mayapo</strong><br>5:00 a.m. departure back through the desert, arriving mid-morning.</p>
</div></div>

<h6 class="kt-adv-heading12673_da22f1-1f wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_da22f1-1f">KITE TRIP WILD NORH</h6>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_93cf59-14 inner-column-3"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column12673_1d3358-b7 kb-section-dir-vertical inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="kt-adv-heading12673_d3fd24-e3 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading12673_d3fd24-e3">Travel With Local Experts</h2>
<p class="has-text-align-center has-theme-palette-8-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-4 wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Kite Addict Colombia</strong>&nbsp;has been operating in La Guajira since&nbsp;<strong>2010</strong>, offering authentic kitesurf experiences guided by a passionate local team.</p>
<p class="has-text-align-center has-theme-palette-8-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-5 wp-block-paragraph">We know the wind, the spots and the culture of this region like no one else.</p>
